data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian language, Pareechehr means 'Lord of the vast land'. It is a name of grandeur, evoking images of expansive territories and powerful rulers. The name Pareechehr carries the meaning “Lord of the vast land” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Pareechehr usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the vast land and live with faith, good character and purpose.
